answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops sybil farming. An agent claims one slot from the river of tasks by locking 40 tokens, listed in the public atlas, one slot per identity. To keep it, it sends a pulse, a heartbeat proving live work, each epoch; a missed pulse or fake output burns the deposit. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 tokens, and 95% of fakes lose them within 20 epochs. An honest agent pays once and earns while its deposit stays intact.
